justifications.unit: Unit tests build a real DistributedApplication over a never-started host with the real fake stores and run every assertion, getter and wait helper, including timeout and cancellation paths.
justifications.guard: Guard tests pass a null app and invalid arguments to each method, which covers the ThrowIfNull checks and the argument validation, not the polling bodies.

DistributedApplicationExtensions.cs.reason: Extension methods on DistributedApplication; unit tests run them against a real DistributedApplication over a never-started host with the real Encina.Testing.Fakes stores, guard tests cover ThrowIfNull and argument validation.

justifications.unit: Only the null-builder guard and its argument check are reachable; the registration path needs an IDistributedApplicationTestingBuilder, and both NSubstitute (Castle proxy fails on the interface) and DistributedApplicationTestingBuilder.Create (requires an AppHost assembly) were tried and cannot produce one in a unit test.
justifications.guard: The guard test passes a null builder to WithEncinaTestSupport, the only guard this file has.

DistributedApplicationTestingBuilderExte.reason: Extension methods on IDistributedApplicationTestingBuilder with ThrowIfNull guard — guard testable without real builder.

justifications.unit: Unit tests construct the context with real fake stores and with missing stores, and run every accessor and Clear method.
justifications.guard: Guard tests cover the null-options constructor check and construction with valid options; accessors and Clear methods are unit-test territory.

EncinaTestContext.cs.reason: POCO with constructor validation, property accessors, and Clear methods — fully testable with fakes

justifications.unit: Unit tests assert every default and every setter of the options POCO.
justifications.guard: The guard test asserts the defaults of the options POCO, which is nearly all of its lines.

EncinaTestSupportOptions.cs.reason: Configuration POCO with default values — only needs unit tests for defaults verification

justifications.unit: Unit tests run every Simulate* method and AddToDeadLetterAsync against a real DistributedApplication over a never-started host and the real fake stores, including the not-found and invalid-argument branches.
justifications.guard: Guard tests pass a null app and invalid message ids or content to each method, covering the guard clauses only.

FailureSimulationExtensions.cs.reason: Extension methods on DistributedApplication are exercised against a real DistributedApplication over a never-started host with the real Encina.Testing.Fakes stores; integration tests deferred (require Aspire host).
